Our customer support hours are:
Mon–Fri: ${BIZ_HOURS_MON_FRI} (WAT)
Weekends: Closed
(Timezone: ${COMPANY_TIMEZONE})

You can also reach us via email at ${COMPANY_EMAIL} anytime.

${COMPANY_NAME} offers comprehensive fintech solutions:
1. 💳 Account & Digital Wallet Creation
2. 🏢 Business Banking & Corporate Accounts
3. 💰 Personal & Business Loans
4. 📍 Open Nearby (Agent Banking / Cash-In & Cash-Out)
5. 📈 Open Invest (High-yield Savings & Investments)

Let me know which product you would like to explore!

Creating an account and digital wallet with ${COMPANY_NAME} is quick and secure:

1. Sign up on our mobile app or web portal (${COMPANY_WEBSITE}).
2. Provide your basic details (Full Name, Phone Number, Email).
3. Complete KYC verification (BVN, NIN, and government-issued ID).
4. Your instant virtual account & digital wallet will be ready to fund and use immediately!

${COMPANY_NAME} Business Banking empowers businesses and SMEs with:
• Dedicated corporate bank accounts
• Multi-user access and role permissions
• Automated payroll & invoicing tools
• Fast merchant payment collections & APIs

To apply or speak with our business team, tell me your business name and email!

${COMPANY_NAME} Personal Loans provide fast access to credit with flexible repayment terms:
• Competitive interest rates
• No hidden charges
• Fast approval directly to your OpenSpace wallet

To check your loan eligibility, share your desired loan amount and email, and our team will get in touch!

${COMPANY_NAME} Business Loans help growing businesses scale:
• Working capital & inventory financing
• Flexible collateral and repayment options
• Quick credit evaluation

Would you like to speak to a loan specialist? Tell me your company name and loan requirements.

📍 Open Nearby brings financial services to your doorstep:
• Cash deposit (cash-in) & withdrawal (cash-out) at nearby verified agents
• POS terminals for retail merchants and agents
• Bill payments and fund transfers

Interested in becoming an Open Nearby agent? Let us know and we'll connect you with our agency team!

📈 Open Invest helps you grow your wealth:
• High-yield automated savings plans
• Fixed and flexible investment portfolios
• Regulated, secure assets with attractive returns
• Real-time portfolio tracking in your OpenSpace dashboard

Need help with a transfer?
• Most transfers are instant. If a transfer is delayed, interbank settlement can take up to 24 hours.
• You can check transaction history and download receipts directly in the ${COMPANY_NAME} app.
• If you need us to trace a specific transaction, provide the Transaction Reference ID and Amount.

To report a payment dispute or failed transaction:
• Please provide: Transaction Reference, Date, Amount, and a brief description.
• You can also email ${COMPANY_EMAIL} or say “dispute” here to log a support ticket immediately.
I can connect you with an OpenSpace customer support representative. Tell me what you need assistance with and I'll loop in our team.

⚠️ Sorry to hear about this! To help resolve your failed or missing transaction, we'll need to collect a few details:

1. 📵 *Transaction ID / Reference Number* — found in your transaction history or SMS alert.
2. 💰 *Amount* involved.
3. 📸 *A screenshot or photo of your receipt* (if available).

Simply reply *"dispute"* and I'll walk you through the process step by step. All your details will be forwarded directly to our customer service team for swift resolution.

I understand your concern and I'm sorry this hasn't been fully resolved yet. 🙏

Let me connect you directly with a member of our customer service team who can give your case the personal attention it deserves.

Just reply *"agent"* or *"yes"* and I'll escalate this right away, along with all the details from our conversation.

To send your receipt or transaction screenshot:

🗳️ Simply *attach the image* directly to this WhatsApp chat — just like sending a regular photo.

Once received, our team will use it to verify and resolve your issue faster. If you're unable to find or send the receipt, don't worry — just type *skip* and we'll proceed with the information we have.
